title: The Lost Lantern
author: Example Author
synopsis: A tiny lantern-sprite begs the party to recover her stolen light from a band of goblins and their bad-tempered boar. A JSON example campaign that hooks into the core campaign's night camp.

hooks.label: Follow the tiny, sobbing light at the edge of camp

monsters.name: Thornback Boar
monsters.blurb: Bristles like briars, temper like a kicked hornet's nest.

sprite.title: A Light in Tears

npc.name: Flicker
npc.title: Lantern-Sprite
npc.line: They took my light! Without it I'll go out by morning!

text: A sprite no bigger than your thumb hovers at the edge of the firelight, glowing dimmer by the minute.
"Goblins!" she squeaks. "They stole my lantern to light their stew-pot. And they have a PIG."

pass.text: Muddy goblin prints and a trail of dropped turnips lead straight to a hollow log.

fail.text: You wander in circles until Flicker sighs and points. "That way. Obviously."

camp_goblins.title: The Stew-Pot
camp_goblins.text: Three goblins argue over a bubbling pot hung above Flicker's stolen lantern. Tied to a stump, a huge thorn-backed boar glares at everyone equally.

choices.label: Sneak in and grab the lantern

pass.text: You pluck the lantern from under their noses and vanish into the dark. The goblins are still arguing about the soup.

fail.text: A twig snaps. Three goblin heads turn. Somebody cuts the boar loose.

lantern_fight.title: Goblins and a Very Angry Boar
lantern_fight.text: The boar squeals with joy. It has been waiting all its life for this.

victory.text: The goblins flee into the night, and the boar, defeated, eats their soup.

defeat.text: You limp away. Flicker sneaks back alone and steals the lantern back herself while the goblins celebrate.

lantern_home.title: Light Restored

npc.name: Flicker
npc.title: Lantern-Sprite
npc.line: My light! My beautiful light! Oh, thank you, thank you!

lantern_home.text: Flicker dives into her lantern and blazes up so bright the whole camp glows gold. Before she flies off, she leaves a little gift by your bedroll.

lantern_battle.title: The Stew-Pot Skirmish
lantern_battle.intro: Goblins scatter for their bows while the boar charges straight at you.
